title: Pad footing, eccentric load
description: Ground pressure under a rectangular pad footing with an axial load and a moment about one axis: e = M/N, σ = N/(B·L)·(1 ± 6e/L). Valid while the whole base is in compression (e ≤ L/6, σ_min ≥ 0). L is the length in the direction of the moment.
author: Alireza
